name: Amano Angeline Hotaru
original_name: 天野・アンジェリーヌ・ほたる
source:
Half French and Japanese. The protagonist's classmate and a close friend of Alice.

[spoiler] She has the ability to look into the future which she uses to prevent disasters from happening. In exchange, she loses memories that are precious to her. [/spoiler]
